title: fisk-ai A2A v1 approve question
description: Asks the caller whether a confirmation-gated command may run. Sent on the task's reply set; the header's request names the task and question_id names the question within it. The answer is an elicit reply approve, since approving for the rest of the conversation is a wider claim than approving one call.

command.description: The command path this question is about, e.g. stream rm.

display.description: The full command line to show, already sanitized.

tag.description: The tag that gated the command, e.g. ai:confirm, so the operator sees why they are being asked. Absent when the gate could name no trigger, which is a command rewritten to a tool that carries none.
